stemBlocks: The kite diagram shows the distribution of dandelions and daisies along a transect in a field. A quadrat with sides of $0.5 \text{ m}$ was used to collect the data. Each square on the vertical axis represents 1 plant. For example, in the quadrat centred at $5 \text{ m}$ there were 6 daisies.
Which of the following statements about the data is/are correct?

1 Across the transect, the number of dandelions is proportional to the number of daisies.
2 Repeating the experiment along a different transect would result in an identical pattern.
3 The density of dandelions at $5 \text{ m}$ is 36 plants per square metre.

assets.alt: Kite diagram showing distribution of dandelions and daisies along a transect.
